name: Artificial Wellness Counselor
description: 1 hour session (max 1 per week) restores 1 Sanity Save. 1% chance you gain a random Condition.

name: Cognitive Defragmentation
description: 24 hour surgical treatment removes 1 Condition. 1% chance of total amnesia. [-] on Intellect Checks, Sanity Saves, and Fear Saves for 4 weeks.

name: Deep Tissue Nanogel Massage
description: 1 hour session (max 1 per week) reduces Minimum Stress by 1. [-] on all actions for 24 hours.

name: Immersive Slicksim Therapy
description: 4 hour virtual treatment restores either 1d10 Combat or 1d10 Fear Save. 1% chance the character is stuck in the immersion for 1d10 days and loses 1d5 Sanity Save.

name: Medpod
description: Week long treatment (spent in the pod) restores 1 Wound. Does not restore lost limbs/digits.

name: Pseudoflesh Injection
description: 8 hour surgical treatment. Restores either 2d10 Speed, 2d10 Strength, 2d10 Body Save, or all Wounds. At [-] on all rolls for 2 weeks, plus an additional 4 weeks of convalescent recovery required.

name: Psychosurgery
description: 8 hour surgical treatment restores either Intellect, Sanity Save, or Fear Save to their maximum, or reduces Minimum Stress to 2. At [-] on all rolls for 4 weeks.
